fills.researcher_notes: Same company-level answer as P3300/P3307/P3308, applied here per the brief's instruction to settle this once per system: Intergas Central Asia JSC operates the Kazakh Saryarka system under a lease from owner AstanaGaz KMG JSC. Evidence: KMG's 2019-10-09 press release announcing the post-commissioning lease to «Интергаз Центральная Азия», corroborated independently by Intergas's own corporate site listing «МГ «Сарыарка»» under its Kyzylorda UMG branch. Applied to this Phase IV row (the capacity-expansion compressor stations, status = proposed) on the basis that whoever operates the trunk pipeline operates the compressor stations built onto it; I did not find a source naming a distinct operator specifically for the CS Zhezkazgan/Temirtau expansion, so this is the same system-level inference as the other three phases, not a separately confirmed fact for this exact facility.

validity.recommendation: No change to Diameter — leave it blank. Do not carry the wiki's '630 mm; 820 mm' union onto this row; it belongs to the pipe segments, not the compressor-station expansion.
validity.researcher_notes: P3309's SegmentName is 'Phase IV (Capacity expansion)' and this is confirmed as compressor stations only, not new pipe: informburo.kz — '4-й этап. 2028-2031 годы. ...строительство двух компрессорных станций «Жезказган» и «Темиртау» для увеличения пропускной способности всего проекта до 3 млрд м3 в год' (Phase IV, 2028-2031: construction of two compressor stations, Zhezkazgan and Temirtau, to raise the whole project's throughput to 3 bcm/y). No new linear pipe is described anywhere I found. That matches this project's own standing rule (CLAUDE.md: 'Expansion with no new physical pipe -> LengthKnown = 0, Diameter = blank') and the row is already consistent with it (LengthKnownKm = 0.00, Diameter blank). The wiki_alignment flag proposing the system's unioned '630 mm; 820 mm' diameter as a fill for this row would be wrong to apply -- a compressor station has no pipe diameter of its own, and neither 630 nor 820 is sourced as belonging to Phase IV specifically. Recommend leaving Diameter blank as correct. (Note: this source also gives Phase IV's target capacity as 3 bcm/y, which appears to disagree with the sheet's current Capacity = 7.80 bcm/y for this row -- Capacity was not a flagged question for this brief so I did not investigate or resolve it, but flagging it here in case it is useful to a human reviewer; something for Update, not this shard.)
